title: Whole-repository build report
description: v0.1. Output of diocle_verifier.buildcheck: every certified program of a repository checked TOGETHER, which per-program verification never does. Static checks on the COBOL (copybook drift between files, CALL resolution and USING compatibility) and one javac pass over all converted Java (-proc:none, classpath = the sources, no network). It is NOT a behavioural check: each program is still verified on its own by differential testing, and `scope.notChecked` always states what this report did not look at. Every free-text field is built from fixed phrases, names found in the sources, line numbers and javac `error:` lines reduced to `file:line: error: text`; never from other compiler output. Experimental `domainClasses`: a customer's own classes put on the javac classpath so the converted programs are checked to compile beside them; compile-time only, never loaded or run by Diocle.

status.description: skipped = not run (for example the whole-set compile when no program had Java); never counted as ok.

verdict.description: fail = something proven wrong (a compile error, a class-name collision, a layout drift, a CALL to a missing program or with arguments the callee cannot take); warn = something could not be checked or looks suspicious; pass = every check that was made passed (and scope.notChecked still applies).

reasons.description: One sentence per cause of a fail or warn; empty for pass.

classes.description: Top-level types declared in the program's Java files, package-qualified.

compile.description: This program's Java compiled on its own, as the per-program verification does.
All programs' Java compiled in ONE javac run.

supportClasses.description: Verifier support classes added to the compile because programs reference them (DioSql): they are not part of the delivered programs.

domainClasses.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Present only when the caller supplied classes. kind source = a directory of .java compiled first on its own, jar = a .jar on the classpath. Compile-time only.

ownCompile.description: The supplied sources compiled alone (skipped for a jar). A failure here is the customer's code, not the converted programs.

classCollisions.description: The same fully qualified top-level type declared with different source in two programs, or in a program and the supplied domain classes. Byte-identical copies are not collisions.

names.description: Every copybook COPYed by the programs checked.

kind.description: content = the member's text differs between files (comments and spacing ignored); layout = the analyzer's field names, lengths, usage or PIC differ for the same COPY (same REPLACING).

severity.description: layout is fail; content with an equal layout is warn.
